passages.text: RAM and storage do different jobs in a laptop. RAM (random access memory) is short-term memory that holds the apps and files you’re using right now, and it clears when the laptop shuts down. Storage, usually a solid-state drive (SSD), keeps your files, apps, and operating system permanently. More RAM helps a laptop multitask smoothly, while more storage lets you keep more files on the laptop. In this laptop memory and storage glossary, we explain RAM vs. storage, how much RAM and storage you need for different uses, how SSDs work, and which parts you can upgrade.
